summary_ja: 富岳NEXTの全体・CPU基本設計、加速部基本設計、CPU－加速部間link評価を別work packageとして追加しました。公開契約額の大差はscope・知財・共同開発条件が不明なため技術価値や工数比へ換算せず、multi-vendor integrationの責任境界として扱います。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds separate FugakuNEXT work packages for the overall-system and CPU basic design, accelerator basic design, and CPU-to-accelerator link evaluation. Large differences in published award values are not converted into technical-worth or effort ratios because scope, IP, and co-development terms are undisclosed; they are used to expose multi-vendor integration boundaries. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_ja: 異なる供給者を統合する設計work packageと公開契約額
sections.title_en: Published design work packages for integrating different suppliers
sections.summary_ja: 富岳NEXTの全体・CPU、加速部、CPU－加速部間linkを別契約として整理し、金額を技術価値の比率には使いません。
sections.summary_en: Record separate FugakuNEXT contracts for the overall system and CPU, accelerator, and CPU-to-accelerator link without treating values as relative technical worth.

items.name_ja: 全体システム・計算ノード・CPU部の基本設計
items.name_en: Overall-system, compute-node, and CPU basic design
items.statement_ja: 理化学研究所は、富岳NEXTの全体システム、計算ノード、CPU部の基本設計一式を、富士通と税込56億6,500万円で契約しました。一般競争入札の総合評価で、予定価格と落札率は非公表です。これは設計役務の契約額であり、将来の量産CPU、計算ノード、完成システムの購入価格ではありません。
items.statement_en: RIKEN awarded Fujitsu a JPY 5,665,000,000 tax-inclusive contract for the FugakuNEXT overall-system, compute-node, and CPU basic design. The award used comprehensive evaluation in an open competition; planned price and award ratio were not disclosed. This is a design-service value, not a purchase price for future production CPUs, nodes, or the completed system.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 大規模な国産CPU・全体設計を機器調達と分け、成果物、知財、検証環境、詳細設計への移行条件を費用化する国内実例です。
items.hpci_relevance_en: This is a domestic example of pricing large-scale domestic CPU and system design separately from equipment procurement, including deliverables, IP, validation environments, and gates to detailed design.
adoption_conditions_ja: 仕様書と成果物で設計範囲、prototype、IP、source、検証、再利用権を確認する。
基本設計、詳細設計、製造、導入、保守の費用を混同しない。
adoption_conditions_en: Verify design scope, prototypes, IP, source, validation, and reuse rights from specifications and deliverables.
Keep basic design, detailed design, manufacturing, deployment, and maintenance costs distinct.

items.statement_ja: 理化学研究所は、富岳NEXTの加速部の基本設計一式を、NVIDIAと税込72万7,200円で契約しました。一般競争入札の総合評価で、予定価格と落札率は非公表です。公開契約額が全体・CPU設計と大きく異なる理由は契約結果だけでは分からず、技術価値、総開発費、将来GPU価格、供給者負担の比率を示す値として使えません。
items.statement_en: RIKEN awarded NVIDIA a JPY 727,200 tax-inclusive contract for the FugakuNEXT accelerator basic design. The award used comprehensive evaluation in an open competition; planned price and award ratio were not disclosed. The award record does not explain why this value differs greatly from the overall-system and CPU design contract, so it cannot represent relative technical worth, total development cost, future GPU price, or supplier cost sharing.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 国際共同設計では契約額の大小だけでなく、供給者側投資、既存product roadmap、成果物、利用権、継続供給、保守責任を明示する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: International co-design must disclose supplier investment, product-roadmap assumptions, deliverables, usage rights, continuity of supply, and maintenance responsibility rather than relying on award value alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: 加速部の成果物、supplier contribution、利用・変更権、product commitmentを確認する。
CPU側契約と同じscope taxonomyで比較し、金額差を工数差と解釈しない。
adoption_conditions_en: Verify accelerator deliverables, supplier contribution, rights to use and modify, and product commitments.
Compare with the CPU contract under the same scope taxonomy and do not interpret price differences as effort differences.

items.name_ja: CPU部－加速部間高速リンク接続案の評価・検証
items.name_en: Evaluation and validation of the CPU-to-accelerator high-speed link
items.statement_ja: 理化学研究所は、富岳NEXTのCPU部－加速部間高速リンク接続案の評価・検証を、富士通と税込10億5,415万2,000円で随意契約しました。公開理由は、接続方式の設計に計算ノード・CPU部の基本設計と同一の設計思想、設計技術、ノウハウが不可欠であることを挙げています。接続案、bandwidth、protocol、prototype、成果は公開契約結果だけでは分かりません。
items.statement_en: RIKEN awarded Fujitsu a JPY 1,054,152,000 tax-inclusive negotiated contract to evaluate and validate FugakuNEXT CPU-to-accelerator high-speed-link options. The published rationale says the link design must use the same design philosophy, technology, and know-how as the compute-node and CPU basic design. The award record does not disclose candidate links, bandwidth, protocol, prototypes, or results.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: CPUとacceleratorを別企業が担当する構成では、境界linkを独立した高額work packageとして扱い、性能、coherence、RAS、power、IP、責任分界を早期に検証する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: When different suppliers own CPU and accelerator designs, the boundary link can be a substantial independent work package requiring early validation of performance, coherence, RAS, power, IP, and responsibility boundaries.
adoption_conditions_ja: 候補protocol、bandwidth、latency、coherence、power、RAS、securityを同一条件で評価する。
CPU・accelerator両社のinterface仕様、test ownership、変更管理、障害責任を契約化する。
adoption_conditions_en: Evaluate candidate protocols, bandwidth, latency, coherence, power, RAS, and security under matched conditions.
Contract interface specifications, test ownership, change control, and fault responsibility across CPU and accelerator suppliers.
